title: Orchestra PageSpec
description: Machine contract for an AI-generated page composition against this design-repo. Distinct from and additive to schema/schema.json, which validates this design-repo's OWN internal shape (tokens/primitives/components/sections/templates), not a generated page. A PageSpec instance validating here with zero errors is necessary but not sufficient — schema/semantic_validate.mjs enforces the cross-file rules JSON Schema structurally cannot express (template/node-sequence agreement, per-section content contracts in sections/content-contracts.json, compatibility/graph.json rhythm rules, and per-instance maxWords word counts).

basedOnTemplate.description: Must be one of the 7 real templates in templates/templates.json. semantic_validate.mjs cross-references this field against that template's own node list — nodes[] alone is not enough (MASTER-GUIDE 3.3).

route.description: Either a real route from ia.json or a new route matching basedOnTemplate's routePattern (e.g. '/product/new-slug' for template.product-detail).

theme.description: Only theme instance this repo declares — see registry.manifest.json#theme.

section.description: Closed to the 24 real sections in sections/sections.json + tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json. No other id may be instantiated.

index.description: Required only for repeatable sections with an exactCountPerPage in sections/content-contracts.json (currently narrative.product-feature, index 1-3). Omit for non-repeatable sections.

content.description: Section-specific fields. This schema only requires the field to be an object; sections/content-contracts.json's per-section required/maxWords/enum rules are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.mjs, since JSON Schema's draft-07 additionalProperties:false on a shared base cannot see per-branch properties added by 24 independent variants without an enormous duplicated oneOf (MASTER-GUIDE / BUILD-GUIDE 2.5 known trap) — the semantic validator loads content-contracts.json directly and is the single source of truth for content shape, avoiding the two-authoritative-sources divergence risk that a duplicated oneOf here would create.

allowed.description: Closed to motion/motion-spec.json's closedFieldSet. An empty array is valid for sections with no measured motion (e.g. hero.product, hero.about).

reducedMotionFallback.description: Required on every node, including ones with allowed: [] — state explicitly what happens (or that nothing animates) under prefers-reduced-motion.

assetRoleRef.description: Closed to assets/asset-roles.json's roles. Any media-bearing content field's assetRole must be one of these — never a bare string like 'image' or 'src'.
